faq.title: Before you request a demo.
faq.subtitle: The questions care home directors, home care leads, and hospital teams ask us most often.

q0.question: What does onboarding look like?
q0.answer: We support the migration of existing records and train the teams on site. The precise timeline is defined after auditing the institution during the demo.

q1.question: How do you integrate with our existing system?
q1.answer: Documented REST API. Synchronization possible via webhooks and CSV/JSON exports. Native HL7/FHIR integration for hospitals is in development and will ship in a future release.

q2.question: What if we decide to leave?
q2.answer: Your data is yours. Full export on demand, no fees, in open formats (CSV, JSON). Precise exit terms are defined in the contract.

q3.question: How does pricing work?
q3.answer: Personalized quote issued after a 30-minute demo, based on the size of the institution, the modules chosen, and the number of users.

q4.question: Where is the data hosted?
q4.answer: In Switzerland — at Infomaniak, in Geneva. Switzerland benefits from an EU adequacy decision, so this hosting is fully GDPR-compatible for European customers. Patient data never leaves that infrastructure.

q5.question: How do I request a demo?
q5.answer: Request a 30-minute demo via the contact form or by email. We then issue a personalized quote once we've understood your needs.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How CareBond collects, uses and protects your personal data under the nLPD.
privacy.intro: CareBond SA handles your personal data carefully, in compliance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nLPD), with the EU GDPR where it applies to visitors from the EU, and with international best practices. This policy describes what we collect on this marketing site, why, and what rights you have.

controller.heading: 1. Data controller
controller.body: The controller of personal data collected via carebond.ch is CareBond SA, based in Geneva, Switzerland. For any question about your data, write to us at contact@carebond.ch.

data.heading: 2. Data collected
data.body: We collect only the data you voluntarily provide via the contact form: full name, professional email address, name of your institution, type of facility (care home, home care, hospital, clinic, other) and the content of your message. We do not collect advertising identifiers, nor browser fingerprints. The site contains no third-party tracking cookies.

purposes.heading: 3. Purposes
purposes.body: Your data is used exclusively to respond to your demo or information request, schedule a conversation, and where appropriate prepare a personalized quote. We do not use it for automated marketing or profiling.

legalBasis.heading: 4. Legal basis
legalBasis.body: Processing of your data is based on your explicit consent (voluntary form submission) and on our legitimate interest in responding to your business inquiry, in accordance with the nLPD and, where applicable, the GDPR.

recipients.heading: 5. Recipients and processors
recipients.body: Your data is accessible only to CareBond SA's internal team. We use two technical processors: (a) Vercel Inc. for site hosting (fra1 region, Frankfurt, EU); (b) Resend Inc. for delivering contact form emails. No other third party receives your data.

transfers.heading: 6. International transfers
transfers.body: Vercel Inc. and Resend Inc. are US-based companies. Data passes through their infrastructure as part of the technical operation of the site and form. These transfers are governed by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and each provider's compliance commitments. Vercel's primary hosting region for this site is in the European Union (Frankfurt).

retention.heading: 7. Retention
retention.body: Messages received via the contact form are kept in our mailbox for as long as needed to process your request, then archived or deleted according to our internal document management practices. You may request deletion of your data at any time.

rights.heading: 8. Your rights
rights.body: You have rights of access, rectification, deletion, portability, objection, and restriction of processing of your data. To exercise these rights, write to us at contact@carebond.ch describing the nature of your request. You may also lodge a complaint with the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC) or with your local data protection authority (for example, the AEPD in Spain).

security.heading: 9. Security
security.body: The site uses TLS 1.3 to encrypt exchanges between your browser and our servers. Form data travels encrypted in transit at every hop: your device, the Vercel infrastructure and the final inbox.

cookies.heading: 10. Cookies and trackers
cookies.body: This site currently uses no audience measurement or marketing cookies. Only strictly necessary cookies (for example, language preference) may be set. See our cookie policy for details.

changes.heading: 11. Changes
changes.body: This policy may be updated to reflect technical, legal, or organizational changes. The last-updated date is shown at the top of this page.

contact.body: For any question about this policy or about how we process your data, write to us at

typography.heading: Typography
typography.body: The site uses the Inter typeface, designed by Rasmus Andersson (rsms.me/inter), distributed under the SIL Open Font License.

openSource.heading: Open-source software
openSource.body: Built with Next.js (Vercel), React (Meta), Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, next-intl, react-hook-form, Zod, and many other open-source libraries. Thanks to the hundreds of contributors who make this work possible.

ems.title: Run a care home without paperwork or blind spots.
ems.subtitle: Digital rounds, native audit log, multi-site from a single console. Built for directors who want to see clearly without micromanaging.
ems.metaDescription: CareBond solution for care homes: multi-site oversight, native audit log, digital rounds, multi-team granular RBAC.
ems.visualAlt: 3D isometric plan of a nursing home — memory care wing, therapeutic garden, main lobby

problem.heading: Day-to-day life in a care home is still too often paper and phone calls.
problem.intro: Every hour spent filling a binder is an hour not spent with residents. CareBond gives those hours back to care.

points.p0: The day's rounds live on a piece of paper that gets misplaced, and handover to the next shift happens via phone call.
points.p1: Families call three times a week for updates — and nobody really has the time to respond properly.
points.p2: An external audit requires weeks of preparation to gather the right files in the right format.
points.p3: Residents who don't speak the care team's language — and their families — face a constant language barrier.

features.heading: A platform designed for the reality of a care home.
features.intro: Not a generic ERP retrofitted for healthcare. Designed from line one for the reality of care: data protection, traceability, and friction-free audits.

f0.title: Multi-facility oversight
f0.description: Multiple homes from a single console. Comparable KPIs, strict data separation, granular RBAC per team and site.

f1.title: Native audit log
f1.description: Every access and modification logged immutably. Documentation ready for your internal and external audits.

f2.title: Multilingual chat
f2.description: Resident and caregiver don't share a language — yet each reads in their own. Barrier gone, communication stays.

f3.title: Multi-team & shared reports
f3.description: Management, caregivers, housekeeping, external providers — each with their access level and interface, with granular permissions. Reports, consultations and vitals recorded by one caregiver are instantly visible to every professional assigned to the same resident — no more information gaps between shifts. A filtered mini-report is sent in parallel to the family.

features.roadmap: Integrations with care assessment systems (BESA, RAI, PLAISIR) under study for a future release.

cta.title: See CareBond with your care home in mind.
cta.description: A 30-minute demo on your real cases: size, modules chosen, a typical resident's journey at your facility.

home-care.title: Trust at a distance, without intrusive surveillance.
home-care.subtitle: GPS visit validation, cryptographically signed reports, opt-in livestream from the patient. Built for home care services.
home-care.metaDescription: CareBond solution for home care: GPS visit validation, cryptographically signed reports, opt-in livestream, family mini-reports.
home-care.visualAlt: Preview of the family app — daily mini-report and livestream feed activated by the patient

problem.heading: Home care is trust — and it's built or broken with every visit.
problem.intro: At a distance, families have no proof the visit happened, caregivers can't communicate everything in a text, and management has no time to verify everything by hand.

points.p0: Families call to find out if the morning visit went well — over and over.
points.p1: The caregiver writes a paper report that ends up in a pile at month-end.
points.p2: Critical alerts get lost between WhatsApp, texts and missed calls.
points.p3: Confirming presence at the patient's home means photos or calls — time-consuming and unreliable.

features.heading: Every visit validated, without disturbing anyone.
features.intro: The tools home care teams need to do their job without wasting time proving they did it.

f0.title: GPS visit validation
f0.description: Automatic geofencing at the patient's home. Presence is confirmed without action, and the family receives the notification.

f1.title: HMAC-signed reports, shared across the team
f1.description: Every visit report is cryptographically signed and instantly visible to every caregiver assigned to the same patient — morning shift, evening shift, lead nurse. Ready for billing and audit. A filtered mini-report is sent in parallel to the family.

f2.title: Opt-in livestream
f2.description: The camera is initiated by the professional and never recorded: live stream only, with a full access log. The patient controls their privacy mode to cut it off at any time.

f3.title: Prioritized alerts
f3.description: Urgent first, the rest queues up. No more critical alert lost in a message thread.

cta.title: See CareBond with your home care service.
cta.description: 30 minutes to understand the reality of your operation and calibrate the demo on the modules that matter to you.

recovery.title: Recovery doesn't end at discharge.
recovery.subtitle: When a patient goes home to recover, communication shouldn't stop. CareBond keeps the recovering patient, their care professional and their family connected — guided check-ins, secure chat, video on the professional's terms, and automatic family mini-reports.
recovery.metaDescription: CareBond for post-hospital recovery and rehabilitation: guided patient check-ins, secure chat, professional-led video and automatic family mini-reports. A communication layer hosted in Switzerland with data protection by design (GDPR and nLPD).
recovery.visualAlt: Patient app preview — recovery home screen with check-ins, chat and video

problem.heading: After discharge, the patient is suddenly on their own.
problem.intro: The hardest part of recovery often happens at home — where the care team can no longer see how things are going and the family is left guessing.

points.p0: Back home, the patient loses the daily contact with the care team they had on the ward.
points.p1: The family worries from a distance and calls again and again for reassurance.
points.p2: Questions and warning signs wait until the next appointment — or a trip back to the emergency department.
points.p3: Nobody has a simple, structured way to know whether recovery is on track.

features.heading: A communication line that follows the patient home.
features.intro: Not remote medical monitoring — a structured communication channel that keeps everyone connected through recovery. The care professional stays in control of what happens and when.

f0.title: Guided check-ins
f0.description: The patient self-reports how they feel and how recovery is progressing, in a few taps. Always self-reported, never an automated diagnosis.

f1.title: Secure chat with the care team
f1.description: A direct, traceable line to the assigned professional, available on the professional's terms — no messages at night, no intrusion.

f2.title: Professional-led video consults
f2.description: Video calls the care professional starts when a check-in warrants a closer look — without the patient traveling back in.

f3.title: Automatic family mini-reports
f3.description: The family receives filtered updates and peace of mind from a distance, without ever seeing the full record.

cta.title: See CareBond follow a recovery.
cta.description: 30 minutes to map a typical recovery journey at your facility and calibrate the demo on the modules that matter to you.

hospitals.title: A platform designed to integrate with your EMR.
hospitals.subtitle: Documented REST API, HL7/FHIR integration in development, granular RBAC, and immutable audit log. 3D plans as a custom service. A segment we are building toward.
hospitals.metaDescription: CareBond solution for hospitals: documented REST API, HL7/FHIR integration in development, granular RBAC, 3D plans as a service.
hospitals.visualAlt: Isometric 3D floor plan of a hospital — operating theaters, MRI suite, ward, laboratory, main lobby, with a signposted route

problem.heading: In a hospital, time lost finding your way or re-keying data is care lost.
problem.intro: Visitors get lost in corridors. Systems don't talk to each other. Cross-cutting data protection audits take weeks. And each department has its own tools.

points.p0: Visitors and outpatients wander the corridors, and any reception desk ends up doubling as an info desk.
points.p1: Your current EMR doesn't talk to your scheduling tool, your reports, or your cross-departmental patient record.
points.p2: A data protection audit means clicking through five different systems to assemble one file.
points.p3: Each service (ER, medicine, radiology) manages its own permissions — no consistency, no unified RBAC.

features.heading: A platform built to integrate, not to replace.
features.intro: CareBond doesn't aim to replace your EMR, but to integrate with it (documented REST API available today; HL7/FHIR integration in development) — closing the gaps and adding what was missing: indoor wayfinding, multilingual communication, cross-departmental audit.

f0.title: Documented REST API, HL7/FHIR in development
f0.description: Documented REST API available today. Synchronization via webhooks and native HL7/FHIR integration in development, for an upcoming release.

f1.title: Granular RBAC
f1.description: Granular permissions per role and per module, with strict data separation between institutions.

f2.title: Immutable audit log
f2.description: Every action logged, exportable. A trail ready for your hospital and data protection audits.

f3.title: 3D plans (service)
f3.description: As a custom service, isometric modeling of your building to guide visitors and families on the entrance screens.

cta.title: See CareBond with your hospital constraints.
cta.description: 30 minutes to discuss EMR integration, your regulatory requirements, and the modules relevant to your services.

clinics.title: Premium patient experience, in your brand.
clinics.subtitle: Multilingual chat for international patients and hosting in Switzerland. A segment we are building toward.
clinics.metaDescription: CareBond solution for private clinics: multilingual chat, hosting in Switzerland, data protection by design (GDPR and nLPD).
clinics.visualAlt: Multilingual chat preview — FR↔ES messages translated in real time with caregiver control

problem.heading: A private clinic is neither a hospital nor a care home — its constraints are unique.
problem.intro: International patients, strong clinic brand, telemedicine between physical consultations, expectation of premium experience at every touchpoint.

points.p0: Your patients come from everywhere and don't always speak your team's language. The language barrier is a daily reality.
points.p1: Your clinic brand is an asset. You don't want a third-party platform diluting it with its own branding.
points.p2: Telemedicine between two physical appointments is expected, not optional.
points.p3: Your VIP patients demand a level of confidentiality that a consumer-grade tool can't guarantee.

features.heading: A professional platform, in your image.
features.intro: CareBond's technical foundation, your branded interface and experience. With all the multilingual and data protection capabilities from day one.

f0.title: Multilingual chat, controlled by the caregiver
f0.description: Each message in each person's language. The caregiver enables or disables the chat depending on the clinical context.

f1.title: Customizable branding (roadmap)
f1.description: Brand customization for private clinics is planned on the roadmap.

f2.title: Premium confidentiality
f2.description: Immutable audit log, TLS 1.3 encryption, exclusive Swiss hosting. Clinical data never leaves that infrastructure.

f3.title: International patients
f3.description: Hosting in Switzerland, accessible via web for your patients who travel or live abroad.

cta.title: See CareBond with your clinic in mind.
cta.description: 30 minutes to explore how to keep your brand and patient experience while gaining multilingual capabilities and Swiss-grade privacy.

about.title: Care, better connected.
about.subtitle: CareBond is a communication platform for care — born in Switzerland and built for care homes, home care, hospitals and clinics. We build the tool missing between patients, families, caregivers and management — without trying to replace what already works.
about.metaDescription: About CareBond — the communication platform for care, born in Switzerland. Mission, values, and where we are.

mission.heading: Give care back the time paperwork takes from it.
mission.body1: In a care home, caregivers spend too many hours filling binders, handing over by phone, and gathering documents for audits. Those hours don't go to the resident.
mission.body2: CareBond gives those hours back to care. By centralizing the digital round, audit traceability, multilingual chat, cryptographically signed reports, and wayfinding with 3D plans in a single platform.
mission.body3: We don't replace your existing EMR. We will integrate with it (integration in development), cover the blind spots, and add what was missing — with no rip-and-replace.

values.heading: What we refuse and what we stand for.
values.intro: Four architectural choices we've held since the first line of code. They define what CareBond does as much as what CareBond will never do.

v0.title: Privacy-first, not privacy-as-an-option
v0.description: No tracking cookies. No ad pixels. No leakage to Google Analytics. Data protection is in the architecture, not in an addendum.

v1.title: The caregiver stays in control
v1.description: Chat, livestream, video calls — the professional decides when and how. CareBond never bypasses the clinician.

v2.title: Audit log by default
v2.description: Every access and modification is logged. Not as an option, not after configuration: from day one, on every action.

v3.title: Swiss, no detour
v3.description: Swiss hosting (Infomaniak, Geneva). No foreign cloud, no transfer to the hyperscalers, no extraterritorial jurisdiction.

location.body: CareBond SA is based in Geneva, Switzerland. We work in French, German, Italian, English, Spanish and Catalan — because care speaks many languages.

cta.title: See if CareBond makes sense for you.
cta.description: 30 minutes to understand your context and show you the platform with your real use cases. No generic demo.

compliancePage.title: Compliance by architecture, not by addendum.
compliancePage.subtitle: GDPR and nLPD by design, Swiss hosting, immutable audit log. Compliance isn't a layer we added — it's built into the platform from line one.
compliancePage.metaDescription: CareBond compliance: GDPR and nLPD by design, Swiss hosting, immutable audit log, traceability for audits.

nlpd.title: GDPR & nLPD by design
nlpd.description: Native audit log of accesses and modifications, built for the requirements of the EU GDPR and the Swiss nLPD from the first line of code.

hosting.title: Swiss hosting
hosting.description: Infrastructure hosted at Infomaniak (Geneva), in a country holding a European Commission adequacy decision. Patient data never leaves that infrastructure — no exception, no hidden clause.

encryption.title: Modern encryption
encryption.description: Modern TLS in transit, encryption of sensitive fields (PHI), HMAC-signed visit reports.

audit.title: Immutable audit log
audit.description: An immutable trace of every access and change, exportable for your internal and external audits. Granular RBAC and multi-institution support.

regulations.heading: One framework, multiple jurisdictions.
regulations.intro: CareBond was born under one of the world's strictest data protection laws and extends that same architecture to the European frameworks. Here are the main frameworks we address.

nlpd.title: nLPD (Switzerland)
nlpd.description: Federal Act on Data Protection. Native audit log, rights of access and rectification, complaint route to the FDPIC documented in our privacy policy.

kvg.title: KVG / LAMal (Switzerland)
kvg.description: Cryptographically signed (HMAC) visit reports, with traceability as the basis for justification to the Swiss health insurance system in home care.

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.description: The few transfers outside Switzerland (contact form via Resend, hosting via Vercel fra1 Frankfurt) are governed by Standard Contractual Clauses and documented.

gdpr.title: GDPR (EU)
gdpr.description: General Data Protection Regulation. Data minimization, traceability, rights of access and erasure: CareBond's architecture is designed for GDPR requirements. Switzerland also holds a European Commission adequacy decision for data transfers.

certifications.heading: Targeted certifications
certifications.intro: Beyond the GDPR and nLPD requirements and the data sovereignty already covered by our architecture, CareBond aims to obtain the international certifications expected by hospital procurement teams.

iso27001.title: ISO/IEC 27001
iso27001.description: Information security management system. Certification set as a medium-term target.

hds.title: HDS — French Health Data Host
hds.description: French reference for health data hosting, considered as a comparative target. Our main argument is hosting in Switzerland.

docs.title: Your legal and IT teams want the details?
docs.description: We keep complete technical documentation available: architecture, data flows, audit log, retention policies, processor contract templates. On request, with no form to fill out.
